import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure and axis object
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))

# Map the BMI categories to numerical values for better visualization
bmi_map = {'Normal': 0, 'Overweight': 1, 'Obese': 2}
data['BMI Category'] = data['BMI Category'].map(bmi_map)

# Create a violin plot for the Quality of Sleep by Gender
sns.violinplot(x='Gender', y='Quality of Sleep', data=data, ax=ax)
ax.set_title('Quality of Sleep by Gender')
ax.set_xlabel('Gender')
ax.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax.set_xticklabels(['Female', 'Male'])
ax.legend_

# Create a histogram for the Sleep Duration
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.histplot(data['Sleep Duration'], kde=True, ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('Sleep Duration Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')

# Create a scatter plot for the Physical Activity Level vs Heart Rate
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Physical Activity Level', y='Heart Rate', data=data)
plt.title('Physical Activity Level vs Heart Rate')
plt.xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
plt.ylabel('Heart Rate')

# Save the final figure as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
